added.statement: The managed Codex root preference path shall converge model and provider values to gpt-5.6-sol and openai during Home Manager activation without replacing unrelated mutable settings.
acceptance_criteria: the durable seed and shared preference source specify gpt-5.6-sol
activation invokes the shared preference merger after seeding
a live activation preserves unrelated TOML entries while setting the root model and provider correctly
the Home Manager wrapper preserves an explicit caller-supplied flake rather than silently substituting the primary checkout

ears.response: converge durable root model settings while preserving unrelated mutable preferences

breaker.condition: the activated root config is not gpt-5.6-sol/openai or loses an unrelated setting

added.statement: The managed resident-agent registry and Home Manager agent links shall contain only OpenAI provider definitions, while external gateway profiles are durably provisioned outside ~/.codex/agents and never registered as agents.
acceptance_criteria: every registered resident agent source has model_provider=openai
every Home Manager .codex/agents source has model_provider=openai
each external profile-only config is durable, explicitly web_search disabled, and absent from [agents]

ears.response: keep gateway profiles fresh-process-only and external to the resident agent registry

breaker.condition: an llm-gateway configuration remains registered or linked as a resident agent, or an external profile is not durable

added.statement: External profile reasoning settings shall be based on a fresh deployed gateway catalog rather than stale source assumptions.
acceptance_criteria: an authenticated post-deployment catalog probe is captured
each profile uses only a reasoning effort supported by its resolved model
models without reasoning capability omit model_reasoning_effort

ears.precondition: the current gateway catalog is available

breaker.condition: a profile persists a reasoning effort for a catalog model that lacks reasoning capability
